The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
